match.title: Pakistan vs West Indies
match.stadium: Queens Park Oval, Port of Spain
match.h2h: The West Indies hold the upper hand over Pakistan in One Day Internationals (ODIs), while Pakistan leads the all-time head-to-head record in both Test cricket and Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is). The overall historical ledger across all formats highlights a closely fought international rivalry. Pakistan narrowly holds the advantage in the longest format of the game. Their lead was adjusted after the most recent 1st Test in Tarouba, where the West Indies defeated Pakistan by 90 runs. Most Runs: Mohammad Yousuf (Pakistan) – 1,214 runs at an extraordinary average of 101.16. Most Wickets: Imran Khan (Pakistan) – 80 wickets across 29 innings. One Day Internationals (ODIs)The West Indies historically dominate the 50-over format with 71 victories to Pakistan's 63. While Pakistan has controlled much of the bilateral narrative in recent years, the West Indies have retained a psychological edge by winning 3 out of 4 of their last matchups in the ODI World Cups. Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is)Pakistan has been the clear dominant force in the shortest format. They have claimed 15 victories out of 24 completed games, largely backed by superior spin options and dynamic top-order anchor roles in recent bilateral series.
